transcript.text: bosch 24 not draining, water sitting in bottom. help

Water sitting in the bottom of a Bosch dishwasher is almost always caused by a blockage preventing the drain pump from clearing it. The most common culprit is food debris, grease, or glass caught in the filter or sump area. Less commonly, the drain hose itself might be kinked or blocked, or the pump motor has failed. To fix this safely, please follow these steps:
1. Switch off and unplug the dishwasher.
2. Remove the lower rack and twist out the main filter assembly at the bottom of the tub.
3. Rinse the filter under warm water to remove any food or grease.
4. Look into the sump (the hole where the filter was) with a torch. Check for any foreign objects like glass, stones, or bones that might be jamming the small impeller fan inside. You can gently try to turn the impeller with your finger to see if it moves freely. Let me know what you find in the filter and sump.
[Helpful to see: image "Where the filter is" — The filter sits in the base of the dishwasher, usually under the bottom spray arm. Twist it out anticlockwise and rinse it under a tap. Typical layout — your dishwasher may differ.]
filter was clogged with food and a bit of broken glass. cleaned it, drains fine now, E:24 gone. also bit of a bad smell and humming at the end before

That is excellent news. The E:24 code and the humming sound were caused by that debris jamming the pump impeller; once you cleared it, the drain path was restored. Regarding the bad smell: this is very common after a blockage because food waste has been sitting in the sump area. To get rid of it, I recommend running an empty hot cycle (around 65°C or higher) with a dishwasher cleaner or a cup of white vinegar on the top rack. This will flush out any remaining residue and deodorise the tub. To help prevent this happening again, try to scrape large food scraps off your plates before loading, and give the filter a quick rinse every few washes. If you find yourself having to do this often, it might be worth checking if your cutlery basket is positioned correctly so that small items aren't falling through into the sump. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
